name: ANSI/IEEE Automatic mechanical-return indication form
summary: IEEE-library form of automatic mechanical-return indication: this indication identifies the automatic return behaviour of a mechanical control relationship.
description: This reference locates automatic mechanical-return indication in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented mechanical controls family. This indication identifies the automatic return behaviour of a mechanical control relationship. The public library uses Q021207 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.
